name: player-wholerun
purpose: iter-465 player lane (docs/PLAYER_BUILD.md): the owner's path through the combined player build as ONE background roll, PORT FEATURE (natural=false): boot -> intro movies -> title (cursor) -> custom MAIN MENU (cursor hover moves the focus) -> MODS (mouse click: the mod library) -> GET MORE MODS (click) -> RESTART NOW (click) -> RESTART NOW? (click) -> the process relaunches itself (followRestart: the roll keeps driving the child) -> title -> MAIN MENU -> NEW GAME -> the tutorial for a long gameplay window (tools/player/gameplay_play.txt drives keyboard + mouse-look through the harness channel meanwhile). Content root = the sr_drive tree (empty mods/: the library shows the built-ins; SR_MOD_LIBRARY=0 restores the old Apt pages this scenario no longer drives). Run with -Gates SR_INSTANCE_ID=player,SR_PORT_FEATURES=1 plus the display/fps gates under test; -TimeoutSeconds 1500.

steps.name: title-cursor
steps.purpose: The host cursor appears on a menu screen after a move (no click: a click on the title = START).
steps.mouse: move 560,470; wait 800; move 600,500; wait 800; move 640,520; wait 2500

steps.name: menu-visible
steps.purpose: MAIN MENU: NEW GAME / LOAD GAME / OPTIONS / MODS / EXIT; the cursor rests on NEW GAME (focus follows the cursor).
steps.mouse: move 640,560; wait 1500; move 660,580; wait 2000; moveitem 0; wait 2000

steps.name: hover-mods
steps.purpose: The cursor moves to MODS (row 3): the selection follows it. Since iter-466 controls2 the cursor calls the surface's own method ('[MOUSE_UI] call selectNextItem() (focus)'); the older builds pressed the D-pad ('press 0x0002 (focus)').
steps.mouse: moveitem 1; wait 800; moveitem 2; wait 800; moveitem 3; wait 2000

steps.name: open-mods
steps.purpose: A mouse click opens MODS: the mod library (docs/MODS.md 'The mod library', iter-465 modlib) over the MAIN MENU.

steps.name: mods-get-more
steps.purpose: Click the GET MORE MODS tab (stage 570,53). With an empty mods/ the LIBRARY page shows the two built-ins and the how-to-install hint.

steps.name: restart-ask
steps.purpose: Click RESTART NOW on GET MORE MODS (stage 300,548; it loads what is in the mods folder): the RESTART NOW? question opens.

steps.name: restart-now
steps.purpose: Click RESTART NOW in the question (stage 525,394): the MODS menu's relaunch path.

steps.name: follow-child
steps.purpose: The parent exits 0; from here every step drives the relaunched child.

steps.name: child-menu-visible
steps.purpose: The cursor wakes on the MAIN MENU (its item snapshot is logged after a move).

steps.name: new-game
steps.purpose: A mouse click on NEW GAME (row 0): the cursor walks the focus there, then clicks (= A). At ~10 fps a hover walk is slow, so a keyboard A could land on a row the walk has not left yet.

steps.name: gameplay
steps.purpose: Gameplay window: tools/player/gameplay_play.txt (harness_play.py, started beside this roll) walks, looks, takes off and flies with the PLAYER keymap + mouse.
